An ERC-20 allowance to Permit2 alone lets no one move the Safe's tokens.; every other allowance may not rise.

A function a token standard defines may instead name that standard: its page, the GitHub org that publishes it and the function's declaration are held by the program, the page must hold that declaration, and its org is compared with the standard's, not with the contract's protocol. ## ERC-7730

`pnpm erc7730 usdc usdt morpho cbbtc safe-1.3.0 safe-1.4.1 permit2 usp weeth`: each entry's calldata and EIP-712 descriptors in the pinned ERC-7730 registry, and each ERC-8176 attestation checked, for the entries the operation touches and every registry singleton, whose EIP-712 descriptor a wallet applies to the Safe transaction itself. A second opinion on field meanings, never a rule.
